images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of DuoDiscover. Left: a fleet of worker agents, each on its own copy of the codebase, coordinated by an orchestrator that terminates agents (a), spawns new ones, here one combining A and C (b), and briefs running ones (c). Right: inside one agent, a fast loop co-discovers a target and yardstick and climbs it on cheap scores, while a slow loop confirms gains with true evaluations and runs the fidelity test that validates or invalidates the yardstick.

Figure 12:Yardstick quality by kind on 15 of the 50 SOL-Exec kernels. (a) Yardstick time against true-evaluation time, one point per target, dashed lines at 1, 10 and 100×\timesfaster. (b) Rank correlation between yardstick and true evaluation, one point per truly evaluated candidate, its rank by the yardstick against its rank by the true evaluation, pooled over the candidates of each kind, with Kendallτ\tauper kind.
